mainEntity.name: How long does wainscoting installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wainscoting installation varies based on the scope of the project, including the total lineal footage, the chosen wainscoting style, and any necessary wall preparation. A standard room might take 1-3 days, while larger projects or those with intricate designs could extend to a week or more. Before starting, we provide a projected timeline, and during the process, we maintain open communication to keep you informed of our progress. We aim to minimize disruption to your daily routine while ensuring a high-quality finish.
